svg.title: Card fraud platform: Layer 3 system architecture
svg.desc: Deployable units of the LLM and agent platform and the data between them, numbered per flow.
svg.text: LLM and agent platform: deployable units and the data they exchange
support staff, every question: NGINX -> agents -> MCP tools and the LLM
Airflow rag_ingest, per release: documents -> chunks -> vectors
developer push: Jenkins tests, builds, signs, deploys, evaluates
Arrow = data moving from A to B, labelled with the data; the reply to an A2A, MCP or LLM request travels back on the same call and is not drawn.
Dotted frame: the three agents (A5-A8, C5, O5, O6 apply to each). Dashed boxes: support services without a flow of their own.
NGINX also serves registry, grafana, logs, traces and the Web API (api.<domain>: card data, chunks, search, score over HTTPS).
